programmes.programName: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in the Department of Management Studies
programmes.evidence: The 2026–27 official PhD admissions brochure Annexure I states research programmes leading to PhD within named departments, then lists Department of Management Studies and the explicit Operations research-area heading with production, operations research, healthcare operations, supply chains and more. This is a named doctoral research area, not a separately awarded Operations PhD.
limitations: Operations is named as a research area in the PhD brochure, not identified as a separate formal degree or administrative department.

programmes.programName: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in the Department of Mechanical Engineering
programmes.evidence: The 2026–27 official PhD brochure Annexure I lists Department of Mechanical Engineering and an Industrial Engineering research-area heading with Operations Management and Operations Research content. Department programme page independently says its PhD areas of specialization include Production and Industrial Engineering / Operations Research.
limitations: Industrial Engineering is a named PhD research area within Mechanical Engineering, not a separately awarded degree or department.

branches.conclusion: Current 2026–27 official doctoral admission brochure explicitly lists Operations as a named PhD research area within Department of Management Studies. Other generic business areas are not duplicated as routes.

Current brochure and Mechanical Engineering programme page establish a PhD research area explicitly headed Industrial Engineering/Operations Research. Other IIT Delhi technical doctoral departments in the 41-page annexure have not been completely adjudicated for additional eligible named areas.

sources.note: Official institutional name and current second-semester 2026–27 PhD admissions established.

Opened full official current admissions brochure; Annexure I establishes academic PhD research programmes and exact Management Studies Operations and Mechanical Engineering Industrial Engineering headings.
Full department programmes page confirms PhD areas of specialization and distinguishes separate MTech Industrial Engineering.

limitations: Named doctoral research areas are not separately awarded degrees; stable IDs distinguish host pathways.
Wider IIT Delhi doctoral department inventory may contain further eligible titled areas; coverage incomplete.
